patterns: Exams ask one-line identification: horned deity on terracotta cake = Kalibangan, pipal on seals, Dancing Girl = bronze, idol worship began in pre-Aryan times.
Statement items (UPSC 2013 style): only 'worshipped both male and female deities' is true; no palaces/temples, no horse chariots.
Fire altars (Kalibangan, Lothal) and burial types (double burial Lothal) are common pair/match traps.
Many PYQs filed here are general religion/culture items (Rath Yatra, Bhojshala, Srisailam); the app mirrors this with off-topic deity matches that should live elsewhere.
